newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fairwood shrs plunge on rights issue plan.
newsitem.headline: Fairwood shrs plunge on rights issue plan.

text.p: Shares of fast food chain operators Fairwood Holdings Ltd plunged on dilution fear on Wednesday after the company announced a rights issue plan, brokers said.
Fairwood shares fell HK$0.09 or 16.67 percent to HK$0.45 in mid-morning on volume of 1.10 million shares.
"Anticipation of strong dilution impact after the 1-for-2 rights issue of shares triggered selling," said Edwin Cheung from Taiwan Securities.
Brokers said the approximately 35 percent discount between the rights share price and trading price also triggered selling.
Brokers said they expected the shares to fall further towards a price closer to the rights issue price and support was expected at the HK$0.40 level in the short run.

Fairwood said it planned to raise HK$83 million by way of a rights issue of 237.24 million new shares at HK$0.35 per rights share in the proportion of one rights share for every two existing shares held. Proceeds will be used to fund expansion of its restaurant chain and to cut debts.
